definitions.explanation: An unidentified object left in a public place that may pose a security threat. Commonly announced in stations, airports, and public facilities.

examples.japanese: {不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけたら→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you find a suspicious object, please report it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構内|こうない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A suspicious object was found inside the station.

examples.japanese: {不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{封鎖|ふうさ}→封鎖：18846_fuusa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧だった。
examples.english: After receiving a report of a suspicious object, police cordoned off the area and investigated, finding that the contents were just clothing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧ (suspicious, questionable) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (object, thing).

Very common in Japanese public safety announcements. Train stations, airports, and public buildings regularly broadcast reminders about {不審物|ふしんぶつ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧ means a suspicious person
- ⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ means an unattended bag (less alarming tone)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧ (to discover a suspicious object)
- {不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please don't touch suspicious objects)
- {不審物|ふしんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧ (removal of a suspicious object)
